This post is a bit personal, but I intend it to be relatable.

Over a year ago, In the first stickied post I made to this subverse, I went over the things that inspired me to create this subverse in the first place. Sometimes, when I look at things people post here, and when I'm looking for things to post here, I wonder what exactly I get out of it. Awhile ago, I was doing who knows what on the internet and I found a word that describes me better than any other word I know so far, and I've been flying it in my user flair ever since. Awhile ago I found out that I'm an escapist. Escapism, according to Dictionary.com, is the avoidance of reality by absorption of the mind in entertainment or in an imaginative situation, activity, etc.

Occasionally, I'll find myself around other people, and they'll be talking about things in this world that people typically look to for entertainment; things like sports, the weather, politics, and other things. As apathetic as it sounds, I find myself not caring about the things they're talking about. I don't even pretend to care and I'll just give a neutral answer if I'm asked of something, or point out that I don't have knowledge of the subject, if that would be the case.

Depression, nihilism, insensitivity, detachment, other negative personality traits - sometimes I'd wonder if some of those words applied to me. Eventually I realized that none of those are the case. I mean, I've always been a caring person, and I still am. It's not that I don't care about the person talking about the big game last night, it's that I just don't care what they're talking about. Not because I'm boring, but, at the risk of sounding arrogant, I care about things more entertaining than that. I care about things that, unfortunately, don't exist. Wonder, mystery, fantasy, glory, things that take the mind on an adventure, away from this boring world.

No doubt about it, I'm an escapist, and that's why I do what I do here. Whenever I look at a picture, I look beyond the picture and make assumptions, connect dots, and build a world around that picture. I imagine what it would be like if I could be a part of it, explore it, change it, and watch it evolve over time. Whenever I listen to music, I listen beyond the music and think about what world could match up to what I'm listening to, what the music is telling me, and I create something out of it in my imagination. It's no surprise I can't be bothered to care about things like sports and the weather.

When you're a kid, the whole world is a big, unexplored place. So much out there, so much to be discovered, but by the time you reach adulthood, it's gone. I think when a lot of people grow up, they lose that child-like wanderlust. Be it because they left it behind or because they ran out of things to discover, they lose it. I never lost it. This world may not be an adventure like it once was, but I've been finding new ones. Thanks to brilliant, creative minds, I've been finding new adventures. Like those other people that talk about sports, the weather, and other stuff I don't care about, I wanna share these adventures with other people.

That's why I do what I do here at /v/Dreamworlds.
